notes: Only the CTL page was coded; the Provost Generative AI Policy was inaccessible at collection. Template statements are samples, not Columbia rules; unit_stance for template units reflects the sample text. Template lines that repeat across the three syllabus statements (acknowledgement, responsibility, misconduct, conform) are coded once per template. Reconciled from coders A and B.

documents.title: Introduction: AI in Higher Education (CTL AI guidance hub; quotes the University Generative AI Policy)
documents.summary: Columbia CTL guidance for faculty on writing AI syllabus statements, with three template statements from encouraging to prohibitive, plus notes on integrity reporting, detectors and data protection. It sets no single rule; the Provost policy it points to was not fetchable.
documents.stance_why: The page says "instructors and academic departments have the ability to develop their own AI course policies" and offers three templates from "least restrictive" to "most restrictive" that instructors "may adapt or revise", so the document delegates and lists tiers.
